title: Rav Chanan of Bei Kluchit—Sluchit—Tzluchit

paragraphs: Rav Papa, his son, appears in Ketubot 40b. Hyman writes that perhaps the reading should be “of Bei Kochalit,” which he describes as a city in the Land of Israel, citing Kiddushin 66a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The full heading gives Kluchit, Sluchit and Tzluchit; Kochalit is Hyman’s possible correction, and the city-in-Israel assertion is his.

The whole Davidson Ketubot 40b paragraph explicitly names Rav Papa son of Rav Chanan of Bei Klochit, supporting the local full titles and son direction. The selected Kiddushin 66a paragraph calls Kuchlit a desert; it does not establish Hyman’s city-in-Israel identification. All three heading forms and his tentative “perhaps should read” remain, without a geographical or identity binding.
